Should Affliction Warlock DPS Choose Aldor or Scryer for BiS in TBC Classic Pre-Raid?
There is not a huge difference between Aldor and Scryers for Affliction Warlocks. You should most likely base this on personal preference, such as elevator type, location, profession trainers, tabard style, etc.
 
That being said, let us look at the differences that influence gearing choices. The Scryers have the better items:  at Revered and  at Exalted. Although these are quite good, there are better items available in both slots in Phase 1. They do, however, offer additional flexibility in your gearing choices as you can swap them in and out to increase/decrease your total hit as required.
